references.text: God forbids Noah to eat meat with blood in it, because the blood is the seat of life. This is the first biblical commandment to abstain from blood.
The law explains that the blood contains life and is given to make atonement on the altar. Therefore, eating blood is forbidden.
An eternal statute forbidding the eating of fat and blood as part of the sacrificial laws.
The prohibition against eating blood is repeated, with a warning that whoever does so shall be cut off from their people.
The prohibition against eating anything containing blood is repeated as part of the holiness code.
The people sinned by eating meat with blood. Saul reminded them of the prohibition against eating blood.
Ezekiel rebukes those who eat meat with blood and break the covenant.
The apostolic council in Jerusalem requires Gentile Christians to abstain from blood, in line with the Old Testament prohibition.
The letter from the apostolic council repeats the command to keep away from blood.
Paul is reminded of the decision made at the apostolic council, including the prohibition against blood.
